notes.title: More details about: UPDATE 1.6.3
notes.content:
Hi guys! We've just released an update of the game! We also fixed several bugs, one of which (on the puzzle inside the church) prevented the smooth running of one of the events in the game! We are approaching to the final release of the game so please point out any problems and continue to help us!
Thank you!!
